about: Failure words (the owner's rule: no status code, raw error text or addon name on any screen), shared by the web, Android and Apple apps; each platform's reader test checks every key. A failed core reply carries `kind`, and the app shows the entry of that name; kind `said` means the reply's `error` is already a sentence for the screen (the core's own words), shown as it is. Any other kind, a missing one, or an error that did not come from the core shows `failed`. The reply's `error` text is for the log only, never shown, and no app reads a status out of it: sync and other flows switch on `code` and `kind`. A screen leads with what did not happen ("Could not install."), then these words. `It` is the server or addon the action reached. coreStopped is the line when the core itself ended (its reason goes to the log); coreNotStarted when it never opened.
failed: Momotus could not finish this. Try again in a moment.
network: It could not be reached. Check the connection, then try again.
timeout: It did not answer in time. Check the connection, then try again.
notFound: It has nothing at this address.
rateLimited: It is busy; try again soon.
serverError: It had an error on its side.
unreadable: It sent something Momotus cannot read.
blockedAddress: It points to a private network address, which Momotus does not open.
invalidUrl: That is not a web address.
coreStopped: Momotus stopped unexpectedly. Close it and open it again.
coreNotStarted: Momotus could not start. Close it and open it again.
